text: The ledger's own primary evidence for the stance hard-lock now argues against it, and this is decided by frames, not by code. §1t113s0§.as:326-359 is the battle HUD's third-bar updater: :328 'var _loc3_:Number = (param1 - 48) / (param2 - 48);' clamped to 0 at :329-332, :333 sets bar.scaleX, then :336-343 show a GREY getString(960) label when and only when _loc3_ == 0, :344-347 HIDE that label while 0 < _loc3_ < 1, and :348-359 swap to a BLACK getString(175) = 'Critical Hit' plus Snd_criticalDamage at _loc3_ >= 1. getString(960) is absent from the v0.682 string table (docs/gauntlet/L0/index/strings.json has no '960'), i.e. it is a web-only string. I then opened two 1080p frames and cropped x40-760, y920-1080 at 2x. reference/frames/duel_dense/Nr4fQstqHDM_428.0.png: HP 20/20 green, 26/26 blue, and a THIRD bar that is an empty brown track carrying grey text 'CANNOT CHANGE STANCE', with '150% DAMAGE' (the Potato Dog buff, strings.json['4132']) below it. reference/frames/duel_frames/Nr4fQstqHDM_t435.0s.png: same player, same run, HP 19/20, and that third bar is now roughly 40% filled WHITE with NO stance text on it at all. So 'CANNOT CHANGE STANCE' is the Focus meter's zero-fill readout, displayed exactly while reload <= 48 — the same threshold §1t99s0§.as:3050 gates the stance cycler on — and it disappears seven seconds later in the same fight. RR:158's 'HARD-LOCKED' and RR:178's LOOK verdict describe a transient low-Focus state, not a lock. THE FRAME AND THE CODE AGREE HERE; what fails is the inference drawn from the frame.

text: RR:80 ships 'Forge 700c+2 ore' as an ECONOMY STATIC. It is not a static — it is one instance of a formula, and the tier it names is only the lowest of three. Web v0.717 §1t401s0§.as:1954-1959 reads the CURRENT NODE level, clamps it to 80, and sets the price to nodeLevel * 100 coins; the sword you get is a random sword OF THAT LEVEL. Materials then branch on the same node level at :1968 / :1980 / :1993 — below 30: 2x item 20061; below 60: 1x 20062 + 2x 20063; otherwise 2x 20061 + 2x 20060 + 1x 20065. resolved_names.json resolves those to Iron Ore, Tin Ore, Copper Ore, Coal, Titanium Ore, and they match display strings 845/846/847 exactly ('2 Iron Ore' / '1 Tin Ore, 2 Copper Ore' / '2 Iron Ore, 2 Coal, 1 Titanium Ore'). The android twin is InteractUI.as:1003-1046 with the plain-named 'cost = level * 100' at :1008 and 'level = StageManager.getCurrentNodeLevel()' at :1003, which is what identifies the obfuscated web accessor. So the ledger's 700c is a node-level-7 blacksmith forging an iron sword, and it is the ONLY tier the ledger carries.

Web v0.717 §1t401s0§.as:1058 'cost = §1t1525s0§.§1t9936s0§() * 10;' — the same node-level accessor the forge block uses at :1954 — and the matching menu copy at :662 formats getString(848) with [_loc1_ * 10], where _loc1_ is the same clamped node level. strings.json["848"] is 'Repair your currently equipped weapon?\nCost: [0] coins'. ledger_text: ④ SPD→cooldown formula. ... ① DEF mitigation curve + SPD range/cooldown scaling (wiki gives only direction) — *measure per-point deltas in a build.*
text: RR:195 blocker (4) 'SPD->cooldown formula' and the cooldown half of RR:200 blocker (1) 'SPD range/cooldown scaling (wiki gives only direction)' both close from the web payload. §1t1523s0§.as:2289-2296 is 'internal static function §1t9590s0§(param1:int) : Number { if(param1 > 600) { param1 = 600; } return 1 - param1 / 600 * 0.5; }', fed by :2279-2287 which reads STAT_SPEED plus gear bonus and multiplies by 1.5 while the speed buff is active. So the cooldown multiplier is 1 - min(SPD_effective, 600)/600 * 0.5, i.e. a linear ramp from 1.0x down to a hard floor of 0.5x at SPD 600. THIS IS A BUILD DIVERGENCE AND IT MATTERS: android StatsManager.as:1854-1860 caps at 300, not 600, so the mobile build halves cooldowns at half the stat. A recreation targeting v0.717 must take 600.

text: RR:195 blocker (3) 'Focus numerics (max/fill/switch-cost)' and RR:190 blocker (5) 'Focus/crit gating rule — watch the Focus bar fill/consume' both close from web source, and nobody in this packet aimed at either. CAPACITY: §1t1523s0§.as:2274-2277 is 'return 48 + (§1t7356s0§(§1t9410s0§) + §1t7358s0§(§1t9410s0§)) * 6;' with §1t9410s0§ = 8 = STAT_SPEED, i.e. maxreload = 48 + (SPD + gear SPD) * 6 — so 48 is the meter's FLOOR, which is why the stance gate and the HUD's zero point are both literally 48. REGEN: §1t99s0§.as:3318-3326 adds +6 per call, clamps to maxreload, and pushes the pair straight to the HUD updater. CONSUMPTION: §1t99s0§.as:3293-3316 zeroes the meter first if it was full (the crit spends the whole bar), then subtracts slashUsage/2 in Light, slashUsage in Balanced, slashUsage*1.5 in Heavy, clamped at 0. slashUsage is a per-weapon field with a floor of 48 (android StatsManager.as:1921-1927). That is the complete fill/consume/gate contract in one place, and it also explains the 'switch-cost' the ledger was looking for: changing stance costs nothing, it merely requires reload >= 48.
